description:
Elite Royal Suite and Hotel is a calm retreat where every detail is designed around your comfort. From the moment you arrive, our crested reception, polished marble floors and elegant lounge set the tone for a stay that feels both refined and welcoming.

Step outside and the pace slows down. Our sparkling pool and poolside bar are the perfect place to unwind, whether you are relaxing on a lounger by day or enjoying a drink as the evening lights come on. Secure, covered parking means arriving and leaving is just as easy.

Backed by Elite Consolidated Business Nig Ltd, our team treats every guest with warmth and attention, whether you are here for a relaxing getaway, a business trip or time with loved ones. Reserve your stay or reach out with any questions, and we will be delighted to host you.
